title: Operating-Room Pricing Methodology for Outpatient Surgery — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
**Managed Care Contracting bulletin.** When the services of an Outpatient Surgery Account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) are valued for an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing), the surgical pricing method values the operating-room lines (revenue code 0360), reading codes 29882 and 29877 by their charges and billed units:

**A. Commercial PPO Claim that bills code 29882 — arthroscopy case rate.** 6150.00 USD plus every other operating-room charge times the payer class's expected allowed percentage times 0.5. The case rate packages the ancillary lines (revenue codes 0250 and 0272) and is never above the billed charges of the operating-room and ancillary lines it packages.

**B. Commercial HMO Claim — per-procedure fee schedule.** The billed units of 29882 times 5480.00 USD, plus the billed units of 29877 times 1720.00 USD, plus every other operating-room charge times the expected allowed percentage; never above the billed charges of the operating-room lines.

**C. Otherwise.** The expected allowed percentage of the operating-room charges.

**Ancillary lines.** The ancillary lines carry no value of their own only when the arthroscopy case rate that packages them is paid; otherwise they are valued at the expected allowed percentage of their charges.

**Worked cases (hypothetical, payer class modeled at 50%)**
| Case | Operating-room lines | Ancillary charges | Operating-room value | Ancillary value |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Commercial PPO Claim, 29882 charged 9,000.00, other operating-room charges 1,000.00 | 10,000.00 | 800.00 | 6150.00 plus 1,000.00 at 50% times 0.5 → 6,400.00 | 0.00 |
| Commercial HMO Claim, 1 unit of 29882, 1 unit of 29877, no other operating-room charge | 9,000.00 | 800.00 | 5480.00 plus 1720.00 → 7,200.00 | 400.00 |
| Marketplace Exchange Plan Claim | 10,000.00 | 800.00 | 5,000.00 | 400.00 |
